palette: Dusk/night: slate-blue cloudy sky, dark teal grass, warm grey stone; matches procession/landscape.png
composition: Side view, church centred on a grassy hill; each tier is an edit of the previous tier so the composition lines up

jobs.name: tier-0
jobs.prompt: side view pixel art game background at dusk: a partially destroyed small stone church standing in the center on a grassy hill, collapsed roof with broken wooden beams, crumbling walls with empty dark arched windows, piles of rubble and fallen stones inside and in front of the nave, broken bell gable, overgrown weeds. Dark blue-grey cloudy night sky with faint last light of dusk on the horizon, distant dark hills. Muted desaturated palette of slate blue, dark teal green grass and warm grey stone. No people.

jobs.name: tier-1
jobs.prompt: Remove both piles of rubble and fallen stones in front of the church so the grass is clear and tidy. Add a small makeshift altar on the grass in front of the church, left of the doorway: a rough stone slab resting on two stacked stone blocks, with a worn cloth draped over it. Keep the broken roof, walls, windows, sky, hills, lighting, palette and composition exactly the same.

jobs.name: tier-2
jobs.prompt: Edit this pixel art image. Repair the church: replace the collapsed, broken roof with a complete, intact dark slate-tiled pitched roof, and patch the cracked stone walls so they look solid and repaired. Light candles inside: the three arched side windows, the round rose window and the open doorway now glow with warm flickering orange-yellow candlelight, casting a soft warm glow onto the nearby grass. Keep everything else exactly identical: same canvas size and aspect ratio, same camera, church in exactly the same position and size, same cross, same stone altar with cloth on the left, same steps, same hill, same dark blue cloudy night sky, same hills, same chunky pixel art style and palette. Do not add people or text.

jobs.name: tier-3
jobs.prompt: Edit this pixel art image. Make the church fully restored and grand: on top of the front gable, replace the small cross with a short square stone bell tower with an open arched belfry holding a bronze bell, capped by a small pointed roof with the cross on top. Turn the three side windows and the round rose window into richly coloured glowing stained glass (ruby red, cobalt blue, emerald and gold), shining brightly from within. Hang two long vertical crimson-and-gold cloth banners on the front wall, one on each side of the doorway. The doorway glows warm gold. The light spilling onto the grass in front becomes brighter and warmer. Keep everything else exactly identical: same canvas size and aspect ratio, same camera, church body in exactly the same position and size, same roof, same stone altar with cloth on the left, same steps, same hill, same dark blue cloudy night sky, same hills, same chunky pixel art style. Do not add people or text.

props.scale: Drawn at half the background's pixel scale, bottom-centred on open ground in front of the church (see DETAIL_PROPS in src/ui/ChurchScene.ts)

jobs.name: garden
jobs.prompt: small low garden flowerbed on grass, a few shrubs and clusters of muted red, white and violet flowers bordered by small stones, side view, pixel art prop for a dusk night scene, muted desaturated palette, dark teal green leaves

jobs.name: banner
jobs.prompt: tall free-standing cult banner on a wooden pole with crossbar, long hanging crimson cloth with a gold circle sphere emblem and gold fringe, side view, pixel art prop for a dusk night scene, muted desaturated palette

sanctuary.note: Each tier then had a raised stone sanctuary dais and a per-tier altar inpainted in with Pro Flash. The model is capped at 256 px, so a 160x96 window at (72,80) was cut out, inpainted under a shaped mask that leaves the open sky alone, and pasted back; everything outside the window is unchanged. Tiers 2-3 reuse the tier-1 dais rows (y>=126) so the protagonist and sphere anchors match, and only the altar is regenerated.

jobs.name: tier-1
jobs.mask: x 88-211, y 112-155 plus y 104-111 in front of the wall
jobs.prompt: A low raised stone sanctuary platform on the grass in front of the church: a wide dais of rough grey stone blocks about 12 pixels tall with a flat top, and two small stone steps at its right end leading down to the grass. At the LEFT end of the platform stands ONE solid makeshift altar: a single wide rough stone slab laid on a squat block of stacked stones, a worn pale cloth draped over the front of the slab, and in the middle of the slab top a small round stone cradle to hold an orb. The rest of the platform top, to the right of the altar, is flat and empty, a stage for a priest to stand on. Night scene, muted slate blue and warm grey stone palette, chunky pixel art matching the surroundings. No people, no orb.

jobs.name: tier-0
jobs.prompt: The ruins of a low stone sanctuary platform on the grass in front of the ruined church: a wide dais of cracked, broken grey stone blocks with a flat top, its edges crumbled, partly covered by piles of fallen rubble and weeds, two broken stone steps at its right end. At the LEFT end of the platform stands the stump of a broken stone pillar, about waist high with a jagged cracked top shaped like a rough bowl where an orb could rest, surrounded by fallen stones. The middle and right of the platform top is flat and mostly clear, a place where a lone figure could stand. Night scene, muted slate blue and cold grey stone palette, desolate and abandoned, chunky pixel art matching the surroundings. No people, no orb.

jobs.name: tier-2
jobs.mask: altar only: x 80-126, y 112-134 plus y 104-111 in front of the wall
jobs.prompt: A carved stone altar, about 30 pixels wide, standing centered in this area on top of the stone platform: a rectangular altar block of smooth cut grey stone with a carved band along its top edge, a long pale linen cloth with a simple stitched cross hanging down its front, a small round stone cradle bowl in the middle of the altar top to hold an orb, and a short white candle with a tiny flame standing on each end of the altar top. Small flames only, no glow halo. Night scene, muted slate blue and grey stone palette, chunky pixel art matching the surroundings. No people, no orb.

jobs.name: tier-3
jobs.source: The tier-2 altar's pixels pasted into the tier-3 background (so both tiers share the altar's shape and the Esfera's anchor), then a 64x64 crop at (72,84) recoloured; only pixels inside the altar's outline were kept.
jobs.prompt: Restyle only the stone altar in the middle so it looks consecrated and well kept, without changing its shape, size or position: drape a deep muted dark-red cloth with a thin dull antique-gold border over the altar top and front (keep the stitched cross, now in dull gold), turn the round cradle bowl on top into tarnished dark gold, and give the candle a small warm flame. Keep the stone the same cool moonlit slate grey with dark outlines and blue night shading, low saturation, matching the rest of the night scene. Do not change the sky, the church wall, the stained glass window or the stone platform.
